question: What share of Transluce's FY2025 revenue came from AI developers and from their employees?

scope.included: Transluce's published Independence and Transparency Policy as of its stated last update, 2026-08-27.
scope.excluded: Dollar amounts; donor names; revenue after FY2025; whether personal holdings were equity in the developers.
scope.comparison_target: The description 'independently funded' as applied to Transluce, compared with the shares the organization itself publishes.

sources.title: Independence and Transparency Policy
sources.edition: Live page, text extraction 2026-09-14; page states last updated August 27, 2026

exact_spans.quote: Transluce received 6% of its revenue from the personal holdings of OpenAI employees
32% of its revenue from the personal holdings of Anthropic employees
It received no revenue directly from AI developers as organizations
Transluce has carried out no paid evaluations
exact_spans.supports: No paid evaluations as of the update.

exact_spans.quote: Transluce recuses any employee with a significant financial interest
exact_spans.supports: Recusal rule for evaluations of a provider's systems.

results.proposition: For the fiscal year ending December 31, 2025, Transluce reports 6% of revenue from the personal holdings of OpenAI employees and 32% from the personal holdings of Anthropic employees, no revenue directly from AI developers as organizations, and no paid evaluations as of a policy last updated August 27, 2026.
results.interpretation: The organization's own disclosure. 'Independently funded' is accurate at the organizational level and incomplete at the level of who the individual donors work for.
results.warrant: Each figure and statement appears verbatim in the policy.

scope.metric_scope: Shares of revenue by donor employer class; dollars not stated

reported_value.comparison: OpenAI employees versus Anthropic employees versus developers as organizations

claim_atoms.text: Whether the personal holdings were equity in the developers is not stated.

results.uncertainty: Self-report; no filing cross-check in this docket.

results.proposition: Transluce's policy requires recusal of any employee with a significant financial interest in a system provider from evaluating that provider's systems.
results.interpretation: A mitigation stated alongside the disclosure.

scope.metric_scope: Existence of a recusal rule; not its application

results.uncertainty: No record of the rule being applied is in this docket.

counterevidence.claim: Transluce is funded independently of the labs
counterevidence.evidence: 38% of FY2025 revenue came from employees of two labs, per its own policy.

dependencies.description: Every result rests on one self-published policy page.

shared_dependencies: All spans read from live pages on one day by one agent.

unresolved: Dollar figures behind the shares (990 for 2025 when filed).
